description: Charging points for electric cars (Brussels-Capital Region) is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Charging points for electric cars (Brussels-Capital Region) This dataset includes all the locations of (semi-)public charging points for electric cars in the Brussels Region. The data is collected by Paradigm via a data aggregator. This data aggregator collects data from the various operators active in the Brussels Region. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are station, Car, auto, electric, charging, mobility. The portal shows 3,516 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
